description: This file defines the interface for rbusProperty, a handle representing a name/value pair in an rbus system. It includes functions for initialization, creation with specific types, retention, release, comparison, getters, setters, appending to linked lists, and traversal. The header also provides documentation comments for each API, indicating it's part of a larger system for managing properties within the rbus framework.
